# SPIRV-Headers

The C and C++ headers of `include/spirv/unified1` from [KhronosGroup/SPIRV-Headers](https://github.com/KhronosGroup/SPIRV-Headers)
tag `vulkan-sdk-1.4.341.0` (commit `04f10f650d514df88b76d25e83db360142c7b174`), unchanged: the translator and Sirit
write SPIR-V with them. MIT-style Khronos license, `LICENSE`.
